outline: 本課程之目的在瞭解專案投資的擬定、決策分析、執行與評估方法。其內容包括：投資環境、專案投資評估法、利率與通膨率、折舊、專案現金流量分析、資金預算分配、投資風險評估、影響專案投資之經濟、管理、環境與政治因素，並探討不同因素對專案投資之影響，期提供良好的專案投資決策。
schedule:
Weekly Contents/Topic
1 Introduction
2 Project Investment Decisions
3 Cost Concepts and Behaviors
4 Understanding Financial Statements
5 Interest rate and inflation rate
6 Investment Analysis Criteria
7 Capital Budgeting
8 Depreciation
9 Income Taxes
10 Midterm Exam
11 Developing Project Cash Flows
12 Project Risk and Uncertainty
13 Replacement Decisions
14 Investment Projects and Its Relationships with Economics, Management, Environment, and Politics
15 Project Investment Case Study I
16 Project Investment Case Study II
17 Project Investment Case Study III
18 Final Report and Representation

Mid term exam 30%
Homework and case study 30%
